answer: New keys start at a trickle and the rate only rises after 12 epochs of verified graded work, so a fresh alias earns almost nothing while it waits. Cloning 260 keys multiplies the waiting time, not the payout, and one junk verdict resets every alias's clock to zero. A juniper of doubt is healthy, a plume of proof is required, and a yarrow of patience is the price of a clean panel.
